annotations.title: A content check runner's day record, checked

description: Return the day record (furui-check-day-v0) of the content check runner: the signed RFC 6962 root of one UTC day's check envelopes and their count. Give its SHA-256, or a day (YYYY-MM-DD) to find it through the runner's day status. This server reads the record from the ledger and the key from the ledger's /.well-known/furui-check-keys.json, and recomputes: the bytes hash to the SHA-256, the shape is closed, the key is listed for the record's heights, the Ed25519 signature verifies, and whether the record is anchored. No content, scope or answer text is in it.

day.description: UTC day YYYY-MM-DD, used when sha256 is not given

sha256.description: 64-hex canonical SHA-256 of the day record

name: nenrin_furui_day

lookup.description: ok = the ledger was read and the record exists. absent = the ledger was read and there is no such record. A read that FAILED never appears here: it comes back as a tool error (isError: true), so a consumer can never mistake this server's own failure for a statement about the ledger's contents.

source_url.description: The public ledger URL that returned this body. Fetch it yourself to compare.
